problem: How many of the 28 children in Mr. Kwan's class walk to school, if 13 ride the bus and the rest walk? The school has a big red door.
follow_up_questions: On a rainy day, 4 of the walkers get a ride instead. How many children walk that day?

problem: A potter made mugs in two kilns this week. The first kiln fired 66 mugs and the second fired 59. How many mugs did she make altogether?
follow_up_questions: She packs the mugs into boxes of 5. How many boxes does she fill?
A shop buys 18 of the boxes. How many boxes are left for the craft fair?

problem: How many pencils did the school order? Ms. Bello asked for 66 for the first grade and 59 for the second grade.
follow_up_questions: The pencils arrive in packs of 5. How many packs arrive?
The office hands out 18 packs on Monday. How many packs are still in the office?

problem: Hina owns 38 hair clips, and she keeps them in a box with 7 drawers. If 21 clips are pink and the rest are purple, how many purple clips does she own?
How many of the 38 children at the 7 o'clock swim class can dive, if 21 cannot dive yet?
Keanu has 43 picture cards from his trip. 25 of them show beaches and all the others show volcanoes. How many volcano cards does he have?
follow_up_questions: His aunt gives him 9 more volcano cards. How many volcano cards does he have now?

problem: In Bianca's coin jar there are 43 coins. If 25 of them are gold-colored and the rest are silver-colored, find how many silver coins she has.
follow_up_questions: Her dad adds 9 more silver coins. How many silver coins are in the jar now?

problem: The model boat club met at the pond at 10 in the morning. Its members brought 15 sailboats and 18 motorboats. How many boats did they bring?
follow_up_questions: Only 20 boats could fit on the water at once. How many boats waited on the shore?
Later 9 of the boats on the shore were also put in the water. How many boats were on the water then?

problem: How many puppets did the children bring to the 10 o'clock puppet show? They brought 15 hand puppets and 18 finger puppets.
follow_up_questions: Only 20 puppets could fit on the little stage. How many puppets stayed in the box?
In the second act, 9 of the boxed puppets joined the show. How many puppets were on the stage then?

problem: On Sunday Ravi helped his aunt at her flower shop. He put 23 tulips in one vase and 29 daisies in another. The shop has a bell on its door. How many flowers did he put in vases?
follow_up_questions: A customer bought 12 of those flowers. How many flowers stayed in the vases?

problem: How many potatoes did Inge dig up? She filled one sack with 23 small potatoes and another with 29 big ones. Her grandfather's farm has a windmill.
follow_up_questions: She took 12 potatoes home for dinner. How many potatoes stayed at the farm?

problem: A ski lodge has 30 pairs of skis to lend. 14 pairs are kept in the shed and the rest are kept in the lobby. How many pairs are in the lobby?
follow_up_questions: A family of 5 arrives, and each of them takes a pair from the lobby. How many pairs are left in the lobby?
Later 8 more guests take pairs from the lobby. How many pairs are in the lobby now?
How many pairs of skis at the lodge are still free to lend?

problem: How many life jackets are on the dock, if a boat club owns 30 life jackets and keeps 14 of them in the boathouse and the rest on the dock?
follow_up_questions: A family of 5 comes, and each of them takes a life jacket from the dock. How many are left on the dock?
Then 8 more people take life jackets from the dock. How many life jackets are on the dock now?
How many of the club's life jackets are not being used?

problem: Because the weather turned warm, the ice rink sold a lot less in January: just 37 tickets, compared with 85 in December. Find how many tickets it sold over the two months.
follow_up_questions: In February it sold 28 more tickets. How many tickets did it sell in the three months?
Next winter the owner hopes to sell 50 more tickets than this. How many tickets is she hoping to sell?

problem: How many kites did a shop sell in spring and summer, if it sold 85 in spring and 37 in summer, a lot less because the wind was weak?
follow_up_questions: In autumn it sold 28 more kites. How many kites did it sell in the three seasons?
Next year the owner hopes to sell 50 more kites than this. How many kites is he hoping to sell?

problem: Before the race, Coach Diaz fills water bottles for the team. The team needs 18 bottles, and she has filled 11. How many more bottles does she have to fill?
follow_up_questions: While she works, a player knocks over 2 full bottles and they spill. How many bottles must she fill now?

problem: How many more balloons does Malik have to blow up? The party needs 18 balloons, and he has blown up 11.
follow_up_questions: Then 2 of the balloons pop. How many balloons does he have to blow up now?

problem: A swim meet lasted 2 hours. Bao swam 36 laps and his sister swam 27 laps. How many laps did they swim together?
How many muffins did the bakery sell on Sunday if it sold 36 in the shop and 27 at the farmers market, where it has 2 tables?
A fruit stand had 96 apples for sale on Tuesday. 58 of them were red, and the rest were green. How many green apples did the stand have?
follow_up_questions: Shoppers bought all but 6 of the green apples. How many green apples did they buy?
Then a school bought 45 red apples. How many red apples did the stand have left?

problem: How many white T-shirts did the shop have, if it had 96 T-shirts and 58 were black and the rest white?
follow_up_questions: Customers bought all but 6 of the white T-shirts. How many white T-shirts did they buy?
Then a team bought 45 black T-shirts. How many black T-shirts were left?

problem: Before the class picnic, Ade and his friend picked up litter in the park. Ade picked up 34 pieces and his friend picked up 21. The park ranger thanked them warmly. How many pieces of litter did they pick up?
follow_up_questions: They put all the litter into a bin that already held 30 pieces. How many pieces are in the bin now?

problem: How many acorns did the twins collect? Ivo collected 34 and his twin sister collected 21. Their dog chased squirrels the whole time.
follow_up_questions: They dropped all the acorns into a bucket that already had 30 acorns in it. How many acorns are in the bucket now?

problem: A school library has 40 board games: 22 are card games and the rest are dice games. How many dice games does it have?
follow_up_questions: A teacher borrows 6 dice games for her class. How many dice games stay in the library?
The library buys 10 new dice games. How many dice games are there now?
How many board games are in the library now?

problem: How many of the 40 cows in a farmer's barn are brown, if 22 are black and the rest are brown?
follow_up_questions: The farmer sells 6 brown cows. How many brown cows stay in the barn?
Then he buys 10 new brown cows. How many brown cows are there now?
How many cows are in the barn now?

problem: Lots of apples fell in last night's storm. On the big tree, 26 are still hanging; on the small tree, 19 are left. How many apples are left on the two trees?
follow_up_questions: Next week 15 more apples ripen on the trees. How many ripe apples will be on the trees then?

problem: How many crayons are left in the art box after the class took many of them away? There are 26 left in the top tray and 19 left in the bottom tray.
follow_up_questions: The teacher adds a box of 15 new crayons. How many crayons will be in the art box then?

problem: Tariq brought his marble collection of 87 marbles to school. 49 of the marbles are clear and the rest are swirly. How many swirly marbles does he have?
follow_up_questions: His friend gives him 14 more swirly marbles. How many swirly marbles does he have now?
How many marbles does Tariq have now in total?

problem: How many of the books in a classroom library are not about animals, if the library has 87 books and 49 of them are about animals?
follow_up_questions: The principal donates 14 more books that are not about animals. How many books not about animals are there now?
How many books does the classroom library have now?

problem: At her lemonade stand, Maria poured 24 cups before lunch and 31 cups after lunch. Her stand was at table 5 of the school fair. How many cups did she pour?
How many apples did Hugo pick on the 5th day of apple season, if he picked 24 before lunch and 31 after?
A toy shop shelf holds 36 stuffed animals. Some are bears and 15 are bunnies. How many bears are on the shelf?
follow_up_questions: A dad buys 3 bears for his children. How many bears are left on the shelf?

problem: How many of the 36 balloons at the party are round, if 15 are heart-shaped and the rest are round?
follow_up_questions: Then 3 round balloons pop. How many round balloons are left?

problem: This year's apple harvest was smaller than last year's, with fewer crates: the old trees gave 76 crates and the young trees gave 58. What was the total number of crates?
follow_up_questions: The farm makes 45 crates into apple juice. How many crates are left?
It sells the rest for 2 dollars a crate. How much money does it get?

problem: How many sacks of potatoes did the farm dig up this year? It was fewer than last year: 76 sacks came from the east field and 58 from the west field.
follow_up_questions: The farmer keeps 45 sacks for his family. How many sacks are left?
He sells the rest for 2 dollars a sack. How much money does he get?

problem: Sienna packed 25 crayons for a long car trip. Twelve of them were red and the others were blue. How many blue crayons did she pack?
follow_up_questions: She lost 4 blue crayons under the seat. How many blue crayons were left?
Her brother Leo gave her 6 more blue crayons. How many blue crayons does Sienna have now?
How many crayons does Sienna have now, red and blue together?

problem: How many juice boxes did the coach bring, if she packed 25 drinks for the game and 12 of them were water bottles?
follow_up_questions: The team drank 4 juice boxes at halftime. How many juice boxes were left?
A parent brought 6 more juice boxes. How many juice boxes does the coach have now?
How many drinks does the coach have now, water bottles and juice boxes together?

problem: Two teachers marked spelling tests. Ms. Ito marked 17 tests and Mr. Reyes marked 14. They sat in the quiet staff room. How many tests did they mark between them?
follow_up_questions: There are 40 tests in all. How many tests still need marking?

problem: How many bikes did the two mechanics fix this week? Ana fixed 17 bikes and Bruno fixed 14. Their shop smells of oil and rubber.
follow_up_questions: The shop had 40 bikes to fix this week. How many bikes still need fixing?

problem: A pet store bought 64 kilograms of bird seed for the winter. 37 kilograms were sunflower seeds and the rest were millet. How many kilograms of millet did the store buy?
follow_up_questions: The birds eat 3 kilograms of millet a week. How many weeks will the millet last?
When the millet runs out, the store will buy 20 more kilograms. How many kilograms of seed will it have bought in all?

problem: How much of the 64 liters of paint the school bought is green, if 37 liters are white and the rest is green?
follow_up_questions: The painters use 3 liters of green paint a day. How many days will the green paint last?
When the green paint is used up, the school will buy 20 more liters. How many liters of paint will it have bought in all?

problem: The class collected cans for recycling on Monday. The boys brought in 26 cans and the girls brought in 18. How many cans did the class collect?
follow_up_questions: The teacher crushed 20 of those cans before lunch. Find the number of cans still waiting to be crushed.

problem: Find how many letters the mail carrier delivered on Elm Street: 26 in the morning and 18 in the afternoon.
follow_up_questions: By evening, families had opened 20 of those letters. How many letters were still unopened?

problem: Room 9's art cupboard holds 32 paint bottles. If 19 are blue and all the others are red, how many red bottles are in the cupboard?
follow_up_questions: The teacher buys 6 new red bottles. How many red bottles are in the cupboard now?
How many paint bottles are in the cupboard after that?

problem: How many of the bikes at the bike shop are green? The shop on 9th Street has 32 bikes, 19 of them silver and all the others green.
follow_up_questions: The owner orders 6 new green bikes. How many green bikes are there now?
What is the total number of bikes in the shop now?

problem: A farmer counts the birds on her farm: 47 chickens, 68 ducks and 29 geese. How many birds does she have?
Find the total number of books the class read this year if the first group read 47, the second group read 68 and the third group read 29.
Aunt Rosa baked 45 cookies for the bake sale, all either oatmeal or chocolate chip. 28 were chocolate chip. Her kitchen smelled wonderful. Find the number of oatmeal cookies.
follow_up_questions: Her dog snatched 5 oatmeal cookies off the table. How many oatmeal cookies were still on the table?

problem: At the summer camp, 28 of the 45 children are playing soccer and the others are swimming in the lake. The camp is next to a pine forest. How many children are swimming?
follow_up_questions: Then 5 of the swimmers get out to dry off. How many children are still swimming?

problem: After art class, 15 paintbrushes were left in the sink and 9 were left on the tables. Those are all the brushes the class has. Find the number of brushes the class has.
follow_up_questions: The school gives the class 6 new brushes. How many brushes does the class have now?
If the brushes are shared evenly between 2 tables, how many does each table get?

problem: The tennis club's rackets were left in two places after lessons: 15 in the locker and 9 in the coach's car. If that is all of them, how many rackets does the club own?
follow_up_questions: A sponsor gives the club 6 new rackets. How many rackets does the club own now?
The rackets are split evenly between 2 coaches. How many does each coach get?

problem: A movie theater sold 96 tickets on Saturday. 58 of them were for children, and the rest were for grown-ups. How many grown-ups saw a movie?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday, 12 more grown-ups came than on Saturday. How many grown-ups came on Sunday?
Find the number of grown-ups who saw a movie over the two days.
A grown-up ticket costs 4 dollars. How much did the grown-ups pay over the two days?

problem: Of the 96 people who rode the town train on Saturday, 58 were kids. Work out how many adults rode it.
follow_up_questions: On Sunday, the train carried 12 more adults than on Saturday. How many adults rode on Sunday?
How many adults rode the train over the two days?
Adults pay 4 dollars a ride. How much did the adults pay over the two days?

problem: At Gate 5 of the airport, Kai counted 23 people sitting and 14 people standing. How many people did he count?
follow_up_questions: Then a flight landed, and 8 more people walked up to the gate. How many people could Kai see then?

problem: How many birds were at Nora's feeder? From her window on the 5th floor she saw 23 sparrows and 14 finches.
follow_up_questions: Then she put out more seed, and 8 more birds flew in. How many birds were at the feeder then?

problem: The art gallery shows 52 pictures in its big room. 37 of them are paintings, and all the others are photographs. How many photographs are on show?
Find how many of the 52 shells in Lucy's collection are snail shells, if 37 are clam shells and the rest are snail shells.
A ferry left the dock with 19 cars on the lower deck and 24 cars on the upper deck. How many cars did it carry?
follow_up_questions: At the first island, 7 cars drove off. How many cars stayed on the ferry?

problem: How many guests came to the wedding if 19 sat on the bride's side and 24 sat on the groom's side?
follow_up_questions: After dinner, 7 guests went home. How many guests stayed?

problem: A movie theater has 64 seats in its two rooms. The big room has 36 of them. How many seats are in the small room? The carpet in the lobby is purple.
follow_up_questions: Then 9 people sit down in the small room. How many seats in the small room are still empty?
Then 5 more people sit in the small room. How many empty seats are left there?

problem: In a school gym, 64 chairs were set out in two sections for the concert, with 36 in the front section. The walls were covered with student art. How many chairs were in the back section?
follow_up_questions: Before the music started, 9 parents sat in the back section. How many back-section chairs were still empty?
Then 5 more parents sat in the back section. How many empty chairs were left there?
